description: Deliberate differences between a Rust toolkit family and the Python SDK schema it must stay callable by (sdk_conformance.rs). Key: <sdk type>/<tool>/<rule>. Each value says why the difference is safe or what owns it. An entry that no longer matches fails the gate.

exemptions.google_places/find_near/requires:target: Safe: the SDK schema marks `target` optional (default null) but the SDK method `find_near(self, current_location_query, target, radius)` takes `target` as a required positional, so an SDK call without it already fails with a missing-argument error; Rust only refuses it earlier with a clear schema error.
exemptions.postman/update_request_body/requires:bod: Safe: the SDK schema marks `body` optional (default null) but `update_request_body(self, request_path, body, **kwargs)` requires it and calls `body.get(...)`, so an SDK call without a body already fails; Rust refuses it up front instead.
exemptions.pptx/add_bullets/unknown-tool: Safe: this tool is the pptx family's own (ADR-0032 P3), not an SDK tool. No agent version saved before it existed can have selected it, so there is no SDK schema to stay callable by.
